Implement run/live-index reduction + constant-(s,d) poly-inverse fast path + direct O(m^2) fallback; passes all 3 public samples.

Run `stress` + `targeted` and confirm TOTAL MISMATCHES = 0 (esp. N=2500..6000 non-arithmetic CDQ cases) and `bench` at N=2e5 recording per-case times; if no shell, hand-trace CDQ indexing on a small non-arithmetic staircase and estimate worst-case runtime.
